ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; >98% of the visible ventral surface is composed of low-intensity (black) pixels with minimal high-intensity (white) regions restricted to localized scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform low-intensity region across the entirety of both lobes; high-contrast spatial mappings are restricted to localized ring-shaped pixel clusters (scars) and high-intensity rugose clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes; characterized by repeated peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 units along the continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to pointed, jagged distal tips; the leading edge enters the water with a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast ring clusters (approx. 8-10 visible) scattered across the mid-section of both lobes; dense, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white-colored rugose scarring and pixel-level texture disruption at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; various circular 'cookie-cutter' style scars visible on the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'beaded' pixel topography at the lateral margins, deviating from a smooth geometric curve.
